name: ttms-eleventy
description: TTMS clean-url migration using Eleventy + Vite with legacy redirect compatibility.

scripts.prebuild: npm run check:og-image && npm run ensure:sourcemaps && npm run sync:legacy-assets && npm run patch:legacy-assets && npm run generate:hero-images && npm run migrate:html && npm run generate:redirects
scripts.postbuild: node scripts/run-critters.mjs && npm run generate:seo && npm run validate:routes && npm run prune:assets && rm -f _site.zip && (cd _site && zip -rq ../_site.zip .)
scripts.dev: npm run ensure:sourcemaps && npm run sync:legacy-assets && npm run migrate:html && npm run generate:redirects && eleventy --serve
